author: Apple Explained
description: Apple put touchscreens on the iPhone, the iPad, and the Apple Watch. It even put a little touchscreen above the MacBook Pro’s keyboard. But the main display was off limits. For years, Apple insisted that reaching up to touch a computer screen was uncomfortable, and that the Mac worked better with a mouse or trackpad. Then, just last week, Apple introduced a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen. The same company that helped teach the world to pinch, swipe, and tap is finally letting people do those things directly on a Mac’s display. So what changed?
title: Why Apple Finally Gave The MacBook A Touchscreen
